decision: pomodoro silently projects to count-up at target, preserving all worked time; same session and revision; no auto-pause/finish/rest/ring/item completion
migration: 0008 additive columns only; pre-mode session values and historical receipt bytes preserved in SQLite test
limitations: no service deployment or TestFlight upload in this batch
no physical timer, approval, sound or permission action
shared Live Activity shows total elapsed and pomodoro target; not a tested background countdown-to-countup switch
cache-persisted device report never proves screen visible or human seen
old apps do not present new mode semantics; update both before acceptance
